collection.title: Fiat Punto Evo Hatchback 2009 to 2012 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Fiat Punto Evo 2009 to 2012 model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 15" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Pinch Tab arm attachment. We also have rear blade for this Punto Evo, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
